rechazados.item: Dependency and supply-chain audit stays inside security-audit.
API contract review stays with the Integrator and the SAD. No separate agent.
Architecture compliance is a check inside refactoring and the Integrator, not a new agent.

handoff.regla: A handoff names inputs, decisions, contracts, open items, and artifact paths. It does not paste the artifacts.
